source_caption_text:
Wiz Khalifa says “See You Again” with Charlie Puth set him up for life 🙏💰

Via: @deenthegreat 

Released in 2015 for the Furious 7 soundtrack, the song became a tribute to Paul Walker and the film’s emotional closing moment. Charlie Puth sings the chorus, while Wiz delivers verses about friendship, family and saying goodbye.

The track spent 12 weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and went on to become one of the biggest songs of both artists’ careers. It’s also surpassed 2.4 billion Spotify streams, showing just how far its impact has lasted beyond the film. 

A song made for one movie turned into a global hit that people still come back to years later. 🎬🎶
